## A：幼兒園／安親班英文老師（zh-Hant）

**主旨：** 免費英文字母描寫學習單工具，以及一款能匯出「今日學習單」的自然發音 App（開發者來信）

```text
【老師稱呼】您好：

我是 Guan Feng Lai，台灣的獨立 App 開發者（Lumi Studio），做了一款給 3–7 歲孩子的自然發音 App「Lumi 字母星球」。這封信由開發者本人寄出，先說明身分。

先分享一個不需要 App 的免費工具：Letter Tracing Worksheet Generator（英文介面）。輸入孩子正在練的字母，一張最多 12 個，可以選大寫、小寫或兩者，有虛線、外框、淡色三種描寫樣式，直接列印，不用帳號。
https://open.cait518.cc/ios-app-guide/tools/letter-tracing-worksheet.html

附件是 App 的一頁說明。對老師最有用的可能是兩件事：
1. 「今日學習單」：一鍵匯出 PDF，自動帶入當天練到的字母描寫格，含十字輔助線，可以直接印給孩子。
2. 四大能力：把孩子的表現拆成字母認讀、字母順序、語音覺識、看圖拼讀，和家長溝通時有具體的說法。

App 的順序是先聽字母名與字母音，再練開頭音、結尾音、中間音，最後看圖拼讀；26 個字母大小寫都能描。沒有廣告、不收集個資、可以離線；介面可在 App 內切換成 50 種語言，新住民家長也看得懂選單。

有兩個版本：Lite 免費下載先玩，一次購買解鎖全部，購買入口在家長關卡後面；Pro 是一次付費、裡面沒有任何購買入口，適合班上共用的裝置。家長想先試，用 Lite 就好。

您不需要回信，也不需要告訴我是否使用；我不提供任何回饋或交換條件。不希望再收到信，回一句即可，我不會再寄。

Guan Feng Lai
Lumi Studio
【寄前填入：店主聯絡信箱】
```

## B：homeschool 部落客／評測網站（en）

**Subject:** A buy-once phonics app with a printable daily worksheet (note from the developer)

```text
Hi [name],

I'm Guan Feng Lai, an independent developer in Taiwan. I made Lumi Letters Pro, a phonics app for ages 3 to 7, and I'm writing because your site says you're open to hearing about learning tools. Please read this as a note from the developer.

What it does, briefly:
- The sequence goes letter names and letter sounds first, then beginning, ending and middle sounds, then picture-to-letter reading.
- Uppercase and lowercase tracing for all 26 letters, with crosshair guide lines.
- 14 planets with 12 question types (listening, first and last sounds, upper/lowercase matching, missing letters, what comes before or next), plus a daily challenge and a time race.
- A Parent Zone that splits progress into four skills: letter recognition, alphabet order, phonemic awareness and picture phonics.
- A "Today's Worksheet" PDF: one tap exports tracing boxes for the letters practised that day, ready to print for off-screen practice.

It's a one-time purchase with no subscription, no in-app purchases and no ads. It collects no data, keeps progress on the device and works offline. The interface can be switched inside the app to 50 languages, which some multilingual families find useful; the content is still English letters and sounds.

There's also a free version, Lumi Letters Lite, that families can try first and unlock with one purchase. And if you only need printable tracing sheets, I made a free browser tool that needs no app or account: https://open.cait518.cc/ios-app-guide/tools/letter-tracing-worksheet.html

I'm not offering payment or asking for a review. If it's useful to your readers, great; if not, no reply needed.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6778491147?pt=118326163&ct=ltrp_homeschool_pitch&mt=8

Thanks for reading,
Guan Feng Lai
Lumi Studio
[fill in before sending: owner email]
```

## 寄出前檢查

- [ ] 已在 App 內實測「今日學習單」只帶入當天練過的字母，一頁說明的課堂用法與實際一致
- [ ] 一頁說明 PDF 已放截圖、填聯絡信箱；截圖沒有孩子姓名或照片
- [ ] 信中沒有價格數字、評分、排名、其他 App 名稱
- [ ] B 的對象確實公開表示接受 pitch；稱呼逐封改過
- [ ] 記錄寄送日期與對象，避免重複
